speaker: Doctor
text: Does the shooting pain radiate to your jaw or face, and do you experience any clicking or popping sensations in your jaw when you open your mouth? I want to rule out temporomandibular joint dysfunction, which can be exacerbated by stress and may mimic ear pain.

text: My main symptom is Occasional shooting pain in the ear with eating. I also have Discomfort when wearing earrings, Stress from job, Poor sleep quality. This is only for study purposes, so you do not need to list warnings or many alternatives. Please just provide the best final answer.

text: Given the shooting pain triggered by eating, I suspect involvement of the glossopharyngeal or trigeminal nerve rather than simple TMJ dysfunction. REQUEST TEST: MRI of the brain and internal auditory canal.
